 Live Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, LIVE Updates: Vikalp Tiwari's 119 powers Chhattisgarh win; Delhi set Bihar 225 to win
 By Probuddha Bhattacharjee Nov 18, 2026, 12:38:26 IST SMAT 2026 LIVE Updates: Follow the live coverage for scores, major moments and the latest developments across the matches.

 Vikalp Tiwari has smashed a century against Odisha. SMAT 2026 LIVE Updates: Seventeen-year-old Vikalp Tiwari has produced the standout performance of the day, smashing 119 off 56 balls to power Chhattisgarh to 228/4 and a 51-run victory over Odisha. Two Plate matches have also finished: Nagaland held off Sikkim by seven runs, while Services defeated Arunachal Pradesh by 53 runs. Elsewhere, Andhra's imposing 225/7 has left Kerala facing a difficult chase, and Delhi's 224/5 has put Bihar under pressure. Bengal are well placed in their pursuit of Jharkhand's 148/7, while Chandigarh and Hyderabad made aggressive starts against Rajasthan and Vidarbha. Punjab have struck four times against Railways, with Himachal Pradesh also batting first against Maharashtra. Several contests remain in progress, with more results to follow. ...Read More 
 Follow all the updates here: Nov 18, 2026, 12:38:26 IST Andhra's 225 leaves Kerala facing an extraordinary final-over challenge
 Andhra piled up 225/7 against Kerala, with Seeram Rahul smashing 64 off 30 balls and Shaik Rasheed contributing 60 off 39. Their attacking innings left Kerala chasing at more than 11 runs an over from the outset.
 Kerala reached 152/5 after 16.4 overs, leaving themselves needing 74 runs from the final 20 deliveries. Despite their efforts to accelerate, Andhra held a commanding advantage entering the closing stages.
 Nov 18, 2026, 12:36:35 IST Vidarbha pull back Hyderabad as Maharashtra restrict Himachal Pradesh
 Hyderabad's explosive start against Vidarbha has given way to a more difficult middle phase. After reaching 73/1 in 6.2 overs, they added just 69 runs, while losing three wickets across the next 9.1 overs. At 142/4 after 15.3 overs, their finishing effort will determine how competitive the total becomes.
 Maharashtra have also tighthened their grip against Himachal Pradesh. Having conceded 45/1 in the opening 5.5 overs, they restricted Himachal to 102/4 after 15 overs, leaving the batting side considerable ground to recover.
 Nov 18, 2026, 12:34:10 IST Chandigarh build strong platform as Punjab dismantle Railways' middle order
 Chandigarh have put themselves in position for a sizeable total against Rajasthan, reaching 153/2 after 15 overs. With eight wickets available, they have the opportunity to attack throughout the final five overs and push towrds the 200-run mark.
 Railways have endured a contrasting passage against Punjab. They were 152/8 after 17 overs, having lost four wickets while adding 51 runs between the 11th and 17 overs. Punjab's breakthroughs have significantly limited Railways' finishing options.
 Nov 18, 2026, 12:31:55 IST Bengal beat Jharkhand by seven wickets; Bihar keep Delhi under pressure
 Bengal secured a seven-wicket victory over Jharkhand, reaching 149/3 in 18.4 overs after restricting their opponents to 148/7. The chase never required desperate acceleration, and Bengal completed the job with eight deliveries remaining.
 Bihar, meanwhile, are giving Delhi a serious challenge despite being set 225. They reached 159/5 after 13 overs, leaving 66 runs to get from 42 balls. The required rate is manageable, but five wickets lost have kept Delhi firmly in contention.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:52:45 IST Punjab strike against Railways; Himachal lose early wicket
 Punjab have made two breakthroughs after choosing to bowl against Railways. The batting side reached 56/2 after 6.4 overs, leaving Railways with work to do despite scoring at a healthy rate through the opening overs.
 Himachal Pradesh, meanwhile, were 45/1 after 5.5 overs against Maharashtra. Having elected to bat first, Himachal have made a relatively measured start and will look to accelerate through the middle overs with nine wickets still available.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:50:05 IST Chandigarh and Hyderabad make fast starts against Rajasthan and Vidarbha
 Chandigarh made a postive start after Rajasthan elected to field, reaching 68/1 in seven overs. The early scoring has given them a platform to build a substantial total, although Rajasthan have broken the opening partnership.
 Hyderabad have been similarly aggressive against Vidarbha. Put into bat, they reached 73/1 after 6.2 overs. Both batting sides have scored at better than ten runs an over in the opening stages, placing pressure on the fielding teams.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:48:12 IST Bengal close in on Jharkhand as Kerala struggle against Andhra
 Bengal are firmly in control of their chase against Jharkhand. Having restricted Jharkhand to 148/7, Bengal moved to 92/1 after 9.5 overs. They need just 57 more runs from 61 balls, with nine wickets still available.
 Kerala face a far more difficult equation against Andhra. Chasing 226, they were 110/4 after 13.3 overs needing another 116 from 39 deliveries. Andhra's imposing 225/7 has left Kerala requiring an extraordinary finish.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:46:13 IST Vikalp Tiwari powers Chhattisgarh win; Delhi set Bihar 225
 Vikalp Tiwari's oustanding 119 off 56 balls propelled Chhattisgarh to a 51-run victory over Odisha. Chhattisgarh posted 228/4, with Ajay Mandal contributing 50 off 28. Odisha's chase ended at 177/8, leaving them well short of a demanding target.
 Delhi have also put up a formidable total against Bihar, reaching 224/5 in their 20 overs. Bihar began the chase with eight runs from the first five deliveries, facing a steep required rate of more than 11 an over.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:44:05 IST Nagaland survive Sikkim scare as Services see off Arunachal Pradesh
 Nagaland held their nerve to defeat Sikkim by seven runs in a tense finish. Defending 157/9, they restricted Sikkim to 150/8, with the chasing side losing five wickets in the final four overs. Sikkim needed 42 runs from 24 balls with seven wickets in hand but could manage only 34.
 Services completed a more comfortable 53-run victory over Arunachal Pradesh. Their 184/9 proved well beyond Arunachal, who finished on 131/6 after 20 overs.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:14:39 IST Toss updates
 Rajasthan have elected to field against Chandigarh, while Himachal Pradesh have chosen to bat against Maharashtra. Punjab and Vidarbha will field against Railways and Hyderabad, respectively.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:13:37 IST Bengal restrict Jharkhan to 148; Delhi set Bihar target of 225
 Bengal have restricted Jharkhand to 148/7 in 20 overs, giving themselves a manageable target of 149. Jharkhand struggles to generate momentum through the middle overs as Bengal's bowlers kept the scoring rate under control and prevented a strong finish.
 Delhi, meanwhile, have posted 224/5 against Bihar. Yash Dhull's century as the centerpiece of their innings, with Tejasvi Dahiya contributing an aggressive half-century. Bihar now face a demanding chase of 11.25 runs per over.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:11:17 IST Odisha face daunting chase against Chhattisgarh; Kerala target 226
 Odisha have reached 119/3 after 13 overs while Chasing Chhattisgarh's imposing 228/4. They require another 110 runs from 42 deliveries, with the required rate climbing above 15 runs per over. Chhattisgarh's total was built around captain Vikalp Tiwari's 119 off 56 balls.
 Kerala also face a substantial target after Andhra posted 225/7. Seeram Venkata Rahul's 64 off 30 balls and Shaik Rasheed's 60 off 39 helped Andhra take control of the first innings, leaving Kerala needing 226 for victory.
 Nov 18, 2026, 11:08:59 IST Sikkim fight for victory against Nagaland; Arunachal face uphill task
 Sikkim have reached 116/3 after 16 overs while chasing Nagaland's 157/9. They need another 42 runs from 24 deliveries, leaving the contest finely balanced heading into the final four overs.
 Arunachal Pradesh, meanwhile, face a considerably tougher task against Services. They have reached 110/3 after 17 overs in pursuit of 185, requiring 75 runs fro the last 18 balls. Services are firmly in control after putting up 184/9.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:45:49 IST Arunachal struggles in chase of 185; Sikkim make steady progress
 Arunachal Pradesh are struggling to keep pace with the required scoring rate against Services. Chasing 185, they have reached 61/1 in 10 overs and need another 124 runs off 60 deliveries. Services posted 184/9, with Suraj Vashist scoring 73 off 48 balls.
 Sikkim are better placed in their chase against Nagaland, reaching 67/1 after 8.2 overs in pursuit of 158. Nagaland finished on 157/9, leaving Sikkim needing another 91 runs from 70 deliveries.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:43:19 IST Andhra pile up 225 against Kerala; Bengal keep Jharkhand in check
 Andhra have posted 225/7 against Kerala, powered by half-centuries from Seeram Venkata Rahul and Shaikh Rasheed. Rahul smashed 64 off 30 balls, while Rasheed contributed 60 off 39. Ashwing Hebbar added a blistering 37 off 15 deliveries as Andhra set Kerala a target of 226.
 Bengal's bowlers, meanwhile, have restricted Jharkhan to 147/6 after 19.3 overs. Jharkhand have struggled to sustain their scoring rate despite a decent start, with Bengal maintaining pressure through regular wickets. 
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:40:55 IST Vikalp Tiwari, Yash Dhull slam centuries as Chhattisgarh and Delhi dominate
 Chhattisgarh captain Vikalp Tiwari smashed 119 off 56 balls, including 18 fours and three sixes, before retiring hurt against Odisha. Ajay Mandal contributed 50 off 28 as Chhattisgarh finished with an imposing 228/4 in 20 overs.
 Meanwhile, Yash Dhull has struck a magnificient century against Bihar. The Delhi batter reached 125 off 58 balls, hitting 16 fours and seven sixes. Tejasvi Dahiya has also raced to 51 off 24, taking Delhi to 207/3 after 18 overs.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:12:04 IST 17-year-old Vikap Tiwari slams century against Odisha
 Chhattisgarh captain Vikalp Tiwari has struck a sensation century against Odisha. The 17-year-old reached 117 off 53 balls, smashing 18 fours and three sixes as Chhattisgarh reaced to 188/3 after 17 overs.
 The youngster has led the charge despite Chhattisgarh losing two wickets inside four overs. His aggressive innings has put Odisha's bowlers under enormous pressure and given his side a strong platform for a massive total.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:08:32 IST Services post 184 against Arunachal; Sikkim restrict Nagaland to 157
 Services have posted 184/9 against Arunachal Pradesh, with Suraj Vashisht's 66 off 40 balls providing the backbone of their innings. Arunachal will need to score at 9.25 runs per over to chase down the target of 185.
 Meanwhile Nagaland finished on 157/9 against Sikkim despite Rongsen Jonathon's 65 off 47 balls. Palzor Tamang claimed four wickets, while Satyajeet Bachhav picked up three, leaving Sikkim with a target of 158.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:06:06 IST Chhattisgarh surge past 200, Bengal break Jharkhand's opening stand
 Chhattisgarh have piled on the pressure against Odisha, racing to 213/3 after 18 overs. With seven wickets in hand and two overs remaining, the batters have given themselves an excellent opportunity to push the total well beyond 230.
 In other Elite Group encounter, Jharkhan have reached 64/1 after eight overs against Bengal. The Bengal bowlers have broken the opening partnership, but Jharkhand are scoring at eight runs per over and will look to accelerate through the middle overs.
 Nov 18, 2026, 09:40:12 IST Services build imposing total; Nagaland lose eight wickets
 Services have reached 165/6 after 18 overs against Arunachal Pradesh and are looking to make the most of their remaining deliveries. With four wickets in hand, they have an opportunity to push the total further.
 Nagaland, meanwhile, are 147/8 after 19 overs against Sikkim. They have struggled to preserve wickets despite maintaining a reasonable scoring rate, leaving their lower order to negotiate the final over.
 Nov 18, 2026, 09:38:24 IST Jharkhand make steady start; Delhi lose early wicket
 Defending champions Jharkhand have made a cautious but steady start against Bengal, reaching 39/0 after five overs. Bengal, who opted to field first, are still searching for their opening breakthrough. 
 Bihar, meanwhile, have struck early against Dehli. The latter are 7/1 after two overs, making this a rather different beginning from their explosive batting performances in the first two rounds.
 Nov 18, 2026, 09:36:45 IST Chhattisgarh dominate Odisha; Andhra make a brisk start
 Chhattisgarh have taken control against Odisha, racing to 166/3 in 15 overs after being asked to bat first. They are scoring at more than 11 runs per over and have seven wickets available for a strong finish. Meanwhile, Andhra have reached 70/2 after seven overs against Kerala. Despite losing two early wickets, they have maintained a scoring rate of 10 runs per over.
 Nov 18, 2026, 09:33:39 IST SMAT Round 3: Toss Updates
 Bengal have opted to bowl against defending champions Jharkhand, while Bihar have put Delhi to bat. Odisha will field against Chhattisgarh, whereas Andhra have chosen to bat against Kerala. In Plate division, Nagaland and Services will bat first.
 Nov 18, 2026, 09:27:23 IST The race for qualification begins to heat up
 Two round can reveal form, but they rarely settle a T20 campaign. With only two teams advancing from each Elite group, a strong start matters, and a stumble can quickly complicate the equation. We will follow the momentum swings, emerging performers and results that could shape the standings.
